full_judgment: 2. Respondent No. 1 instituted the above suit for declaration of title in the suit land and recovery of khas possession in respect of .26 acres of land described in schedule 'Kha' to the plaint and for declaring that the deed of exchange dated 21st January, 1991 is illegal and void. According to the plaintiff, he acquired title to the suit land by way of purchase and inheritance by deed dated 13th November, 1979. The respondent No. 2 Abdus Sobhan who had no right, title in the suit land exchanged plot Nos.17 and 31 by a deed of exchange dated 21st June, 1991 and thereupon the defendant Abdur Rashid dispossessed him from .26 acres of land.
